visual_rules.composition: A flat editorial sheet that separates claim, evidence and takeaway with rules, scale and one evidence-blue field
visual_rules.hierarchy: Serif display title, concise sans-serif deck, evidence stage, red takeaway rule and quiet creator line
visual_rules.accent: Vermilion marks decisions; deep blue belongs only to the evidence surface
visual_rules.texture: Subtle CSS paper grain with no nested rounded cards, glass panels or large floating shadows
visual_rules.output_variants: Portrait, landscape and square share content fields but use separate grid relationships and a dedicated square short title

image_treatment.creator_avatar: Local project-owned image, circular crop at 50% 50%
image_treatment.evidence_surface: Original HTML/CSS diagram; no external visual asset

typography_rules.display: Noto Serif SC / Source Han Serif SC / SimSun
typography_rules.body: Noto Sans SC / Microsoft YaHei UI / PingFang SC
typography_rules.thumbnail: The active title remains the first readable text at 360px output width

overrides.capture: Each requested output variant is selected from editable-media.json and captured from the same HTML
